name: Georgios Nicolaides
title: Cybersecurity Engineer
personal_statement: Security is not a feature you bolt on at the end, it is a discipline you build into every decision from the start. I am an MEng Cybersecurity engineer with a background in informatics and telematics, with particular interest in protocol security, cryptographic implementation, and defensive tooling. I have engineered lightweight authentication protocols for passive RFID/NFC hardware, co-authored a pending research paper achieving a 1,807x improvement in LEO satellite key generation speed, and built a portfolio of real-world security tools spanning zero trust identity, AI-powered threat detection, DevSecOps pipelines, and cloud misconfiguration auditing. I have led developer communities, mentored 30+ students through competitive cybersecurity environments, and delivered monthly workshops on offensive and defensive topics.

education.thesis: Securing RFID/NFC Technologies in Resource-Constrained IoT Environments
Categorization of Cryptographic Vulnerabilities & Web Security Assessment

research.title: Securing RFID/NFC Technologies in Resource-Constrained IoT Environments
research.description: Engineered SONDA-MA, a lightweight mutual authentication protocol for passive RFID/NFC hardware. Built a prototype using Raspberry Pi 5, MFRC522/PN532 modules, and validated with adversarial testing using a Flipper Zero. Achieved verifiable replay protection and dynamic session management within Class 1 IoT hardware constraints.
highlights: Designed SONDA-MA lightweight mutual authentication protocol
Prototype built with Raspberry Pi 5 and MFRC522/PN532 modules
Replay protection within Class 1 IoT hardware constraints

research.title: LEO Satellite IoT Authentication Protocol
research.description: Architected a high-performance authentication framework for LEO satellite-to-ground communication. Optimised C-based protocol logic achieving a 1,807x improvement in key generation speed over RSA-2048. Validated using a containerised Docker-based testbed.
highlights: 1,807x improvement in key generation speed vs RSA-2048
Mutual authentication with replay and tamper resistance

research.title: Categorization of Cryptographic Vulnerabilities & Web Security Assessment
research.description: Built Covsaw, a custom static analysis tool for automated Python security verification. Benchmarked against Semgrep and Bandit using 200 Python files. Also developed SafeCrypto, an interactive web platform with CWE-based documentation for secure coding practices.
highlights: Built Covsaw static analysis tool for Python security verification
Benchmarked against Semgrep and Bandit on 200-file corpus
CWE-based documentation for secure coding practices
Revived a dormant developer community, growing active membership from 5 to 50
Delivered monthly cybersecurity workshops covering SQL Injection, network enumeration, privilege escalation, and OSINT
Mentored 6 teams (30+ participants) through Hellenic University Hack — all secured top-20 finishes
Secured partnership with NKUA GDG to preserve the community through institutional restructuring
Built and maintained technical resources for the club
Contributed to workshops and events as part of the developer track
